metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.tec g.GAMMAsys gel-based system (g.USBamp, g.GAMMAcap), 16 channels at 256 Hz, with earlobe reference and Fpz ground. Task T1 presented 12 stimuli (4 contrasts x 3 sizes) flickering at 10 Hz for personalization. Tasks T2 and T3 were an online 4-target SSVEP game at 6.25, 10, 11.11 and 14.28 Hz, played once with the personal stimulus and once with a high-contrast standard. Original XDF recordings were converted to BrainVision format with mne-bids.
